usage: 魚蛋湯 is a noun that refers to a type of soup with fish balls.
You can use 魚蛋湯 as the subject or object in sentences.
When ordering food, 魚蛋湯 often appears on menus as a standalone dish.
In conversations, 魚蛋湯 can be combined with verbs like '飲' (drink/eat) or '買' (buy).
You can describe 魚蛋湯 by adding adjectives to express taste or temperature.
